Turned 33 on Sunday. Writing a long one because the last two weeks were a lot.

## Go-live, finally

Atlas went live at Lagerhaus Spree on Monday 18 August, 06:00, me on a call from Amsterdam because Jens told me to not come and "hover". First truck booked at door 3 at 06:30, a Llorente truck, Rafael sent me a selfie with the driver. Ridiculously happy about that.

Then on the 20th two trucks got sent to the same door. Then again. Nine times in two days. I was in a supermarket in De Pijp when the first Slack came in and stood by the yoghurt for twenty minutes. Fixed on the 22nd. The details are in the retro.

## The retro

Thursday 4 Sep. Sanne ran it, which was the right call, I would have defended myself the whole time. The big one for me: the 30 June date was never real and I let it stand because Henk had already told the board. I said it out loud in the room. Jens nodded. Henk didn't say anything, then sent me a message at 22:00 saying "fair, my bad too". Full notes: [[Project Atlas retro]].

## Tomás

He's doing the carrier API docs and he's slow on it. His review in July was mostly good ([[Quarterly review Tomás]]) but I need to stop rescuing his specs. Told myself I'll let the docs land late rather than rewrite them. Hard.

## Birthday

- Saturday dinner at Salma and Karim's, she's showing now, 5 months
- Noor and Bram gave me a voucher for a sauna day at Thermae 2000, the one in Valkenburg
- Mama called at 07:00 to sing, as every year
- Wouter flew back from Toronto that morning and came straight from Schiphol with his suitcase. 11 years of friendship and he's still the one who shows up
- Daan sent a text. Short, kind. I answered short and kind. That's okay.

## Kyoto?

Wouter is going to Japan in April 2026 and asked if I want to join for a week. I said yes before checking money. Started reading [[Kyoto]] notes. Flights KLM AMS-KIX in April around €1,050, so start setting aside €150 a month from October. If the emergency fund hits €10k by March, I go.

## Language stuff

Mei Lin asked me to write the Q3 report for her team in Chinese this time. I said yes, which means a lot of evenings with a dictionary, and practising [[Mandarin tones]] with the app again so I don't embarrass myself on the next call.

## Running

Paused since the go-live. Ran 5 km on Sunday morning as a birthday present to myself. 31:20. Legs fine, head better.

## Mood

6/10. Tired, but things are moving. Being 33 feels like nothing, which is maybe the point.
